pre_transition_external_mutation_paths.SYNC_TARGET: only branch requiring POST /merges; already-applied ancestry is readback-only
pre_transition_external_mutation_paths.FINALIZE: only when fresh Issue readback is not already closed/completed, before PATCH close
pre_transition_external_mutation_paths.RELEASE_PATHS: only stale RELEASED cleanup when exact stale branch exists and DELETE is required

readback_only_fence.rule: READBACK_ONLY may perform provider reads needed to classify the live path but must raise before any provider mutation branch.
readback_only_fence.merge: ALREADY_MERGED/TARGET_DRIFT may continue; READY_TO_MERGE is blocked before PUT /pulls/{pr}/merge
readback_only_fence.sync_target: already-applied ancestry may continue; POST /merges branch is blocked
readback_only_fence.finalize: already closed/completed may continue; PATCH close branch is blocked
readback_only_fence.release_paths: ACTIVE/non-stale and stale-absent may continue; stale DELETE branch is blocked

retry_contract.provider_effect_resolution: exactly once per immutable plan attempt
retry_contract.unrelated_coord_cas: reuse same RuntimeEffectEnvelope/post-record; do not replay provider mutation
retry_contract.same_issue_drift: discard old plan/effect continuation and require fresh semantic rebuild
retry_contract.responsibility: A3 caller/orchestrator; facade does not own coord CAS retry state

rejected_alternatives.COMMAND_STYLE_SINGLE_ENTRY: Rejected: tends to merge semantic validation, provider branching, and transport error domains into one command dispatcher; weakens exact-plan visibility.
rejected_alternatives.TYPED_RUNTIME_OBJECT: Rejected: larger public/lifecycle surface and higher risk of becoming a second stateful semantic owner.

COMMAND_STYLE_SINGLE_ENTRY.reason: Kind-first dispatcher tends to merge semantic validation, provider branching and transport errors; readback-only fencing becomes command-specific exceptions and exact-plan visibility weakens.

TYPED_RUNTIME_OBJECT.reason: Larger method/lifecycle surface invites cached runtime state and a second lifecycle/state owner; transport replacement becomes coupled to object lifetime.

PLAN_EFFECT_ADAPTER.shape: resolve_runtime_effect(record, plan, mode, provider, supplied_effect) -> RuntimeEffectEnvelope
PLAN_EFFECT_ADAPTER.reason: Small stateless boundary keeps exact-plan semantics in control_transaction.py, makes provider/fence tests injectable, keeps error domains explicit and lets A3 reuse one immutable resolved effect across unrelated coord CAS retries.

decision_rationale: PLAN_EFFECT_ADAPTER is the smallest facade that preserves control_transaction.py as the single semantic/exact-plan owner while centralizing provider effect resolution and the READBACK_ONLY pre-mutation fence without owning retry state.
